content.comment_body: Hello, could you provide the voltage range for the analog inputs on [product_name] [version_no]?

Not every [product_name] base module is equipped with analog inputs; only the models with DC power supply support them. These models operate at 12/24 VDC or 24 VDC. The modules designed for 230 VAC and 24 VAC/DC do not include analog inputs. Where analog inputs are present, they typically accept a voltage range of 0-10 VDC. Additionally, the [product_name] expansion module [product_name] AM2 provides two analog inputs, and each can be configured for either 0-10V or 0/4-20mA.
